title: ET AI Hackathon: Agentic Edition | Presented by Accenture
description:
ET AI Hackathon 2026 – Agentic Edition is India’s premier AI innovation challenge for working
professionals with 3+ years of experience who are ready to build, not just experiment. Designed for engineers, developers, architects, data specialists, product leaders, and technology professionals, the hackathon invites participants to create AI-powered solutions that solve real enterprise challenges at scale. Through a multi-stage journey, participants will design and showcase intelligent AI Solutions that combine the power of Agentic AI with human judgment, creativity, and oversight. At its core, the challenge is built around one idea: the most powerful AI solutions are those that reinvent businesses while keeping humans in the lead.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience
  • Educational Background: Candidates from all educational backgrounds are eligible to participate.
  • Expertise: Knowledge or hands-on experience with Agentic AI
  • Technical Skills: Strong expertise in AI, data, or software engineering (AI/ML, Python, Java Full Stack, .NET Full Stack, Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery, PySpark, Palantir, Graph Databases, etc.)
  • Participation: Individual or in teams of 1–4 members
  • Team Limit: Each participant can be part of only one team

Competition Structure:

Phase 1: Technical Assessment:

Participants will begin with an online AI-proctored MCQ assessment designed to evaluate their understanding of AI concepts and problem-solving ability. The assessment will consist of 30 questions to be attempted within a 30-minute time limit. Top-performing participants/teams will advance to the next phase.

Phase 2: Build Sprint - Prototype Development:

Shortlisted participants/teams will choose a real-world problem statement that best matches their strengths and develop an AI-powered prototype. The prototype must be submitted through the Unstop platform before the specified deadline. The top 10 teams will be shortlisted for the National Finale.

Phase 3: National Finale:

The top 10 teams will present their solutions virtually to Accenture leaders, industry experts, and judges at the National Finale. Teams will compete for prizes and national recognition.

Rules and Guidelines

  • Registration is free.
  • Each participant can join only one team.
  • Plagiarism is grounds for disqualification.
  • Submissions must be uploaded through Unstop before the deadline.
  • Public GitHub repository and accessible demo links are mandatory.
  • Team formation must be completed before the Phase 1 Technical Assessment
  • No changes to team members will be allowed after the deadline
  • Participants may use open-source tools and AI models.
  • Misconduct will result in immediate disqualification.

Rewards

  • Winner: ₹1,00,000 per team
  • 1st Runner-up: ₹60,000 per team
  • 2nd Runner-up: ₹40,000 per team
  • Additional Benefit - Fast-track interview process at Accenture (for eligible candidates)*

Beyond the prize money

  • Solve real-world enterprise AI challenges.
  • Build practical, production-ready Agentic AI solutions.
  • Showcase your innovation to technology leaders and industry experts.
  • Gain national visibility through The Economic Times ecosystem.
  • Unlock new career opportunities and accelerate your professional growth.

description:

  • This hackathon is a dynamic platform where students, professionals, and tech enthusiasts come together to brainstorm, build, and showcase cutting-edge solutions to real-world challenges. Whether you’re a seasoned coder, a design prodigy, or a curious beginner, the event offers a collaborative space to learn new skills, experiment with emerging technologies, and network with like-minded innovators.
  • This is your chance to turn your bold ideas into impactful prototypes. Guided by mentors and industry experts, you will tackle significant problems, push the boundaries of technology, and help pave the way for the next generation of problem-solvers. Join us to innovate, build, and make a difference!

Hackathon Themes: 

Participants are challenged to build innovative solutions in one of the following domains. You are free to identify a specific problem within your chosen theme.

  • AI for Social Good
  • GreenTech & Climate Action
  • Web 3.0 & Decentralized Applications
  • Future of Mobility
  • Cybersecurity for the future and more

Eligibility:

  • This competition is open to all university students (undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral), working professionals, and technology enthusiasts.
  • There are no age or educational background restrictions. We welcome participants from Engineering, Design, Business, Sciences, and all other fields.

Team Formation:

  • Participants must form teams of 2 - 4 members.
  • Inter-college/Inter-organization team members are allowed and highly encouraged.
  • Inter-specialization team members are highly encouraged. A diverse team with developers, designers, and business strategists often creates the most well-rounded solutions.
  • Lone wolves are not allowed; participation is strictly team-based.

Competition Structure & Rounds:

Round 1 – Idea Submission

  • Teams submit a concept proposal document (PDF/PPT) including:
    – Problem statement & chosen theme
    – Proposed solution and unique features
    – Target users and impact
    – Technology stack
    – Development plan or architecture
    • Evaluation criteria: Novelty, clarity, feasibility, and potential impact.
    • Based on submissions, teams are shortlisted for the development round.

Round 2 – Prototype Development & Final Pitch

  • Finalists present their solution in a live virtual demo & pitch session to the judging panel.
  •  Presentations will include a demo of the prototype, a Q&A, and discussion of future scope.

Timeline & Duration:

  •  Hackathon Dates: 15-16, August, 2026 (2 days)
  • Registration Deadline: 12 August 2026
  • Round 1: Idea submission phase
  • Round 2: Development & final presentation

Rules & Regulations:

  • Code of Conduct: All participants must maintain a professional and respectful environment. Harassment or any form of misconduct will result in immediate disqualification.
  • Originality: All work must be the original creation of the team. Ideas and code should be developed during the hackathon. Using pre-existing projects is strictly prohibited.
  • Open Source: The use of open-source libraries, frameworks, and public APIs is permitted and encouraged. You must declare all such components in your final submission.
  • Intellectual Property (IP): Your team will retain full ownership of what you build. By participating, you grant the organizers the right to showcase your project for promotional and non-commercial purposes.
  • Submission Deadlines: All deadlines are final. Late submissions will not be considered for evaluation.
  • Judging: The decision of the judging panel is final and binding. The judging criteria will include:
    • Innovation & Creativity: How original and novel is the solution?
    • Impact & Relevance: How effectively does it address a real-world problem?
    • Technical Implementation: The quality, functionality, and elegance of the code.
    • User Experience (UX/UI): How intuitive and well-designed is the final product?
    • Presentation: Clarity and persuasiveness of your final pitch.
  • The organizers reserve the right to modify any rules or timelines. All changes will be communicated clearly to the participants.

Rewards & Prizes:

  • Winner: $1000
  • First Runner-Up: $500
  • Second Runner-Up: $250
  • All finalists will receive Certificates of Recognition

Speak to Agents: The new language of Brand Visibility

The way we interact with technology is changing. From intelligent assistants to autonomous agents, the next wave of innovation is being built by those who dare to think differently.

At Adobe University Hackathon 2026, you'll take on a challenge that pushes the boundaries of AI, creativity, and problem-solving. The problem statement is coming soon - but one thing is certain: your ideas have the power to shape what's next.

Click here to learn more about Adobe.

Compete with the brightest innovators from across the country, win exciting rewards, and stand a chance to earn an internship opportunity with Adobe India.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Open to engineering students across all years and branches
  • Participants must register in teams of 2-3 members.
  • Cross-college teams are not allowed.
  • Cross-year teams are allowed.
  • Cross-specialisation teams are allowed.

Rules and Guidelines:

  • All members of the team have to register with their WhatsApp numbers.
  • All members of the team must register with their official university ID. In case you do not have one, you can register with your Gmail ID.
  • All members of a team should be from the same institute/university.
  • One student cannot be a part of more than one team.

Rounds and Stages:

Round 1 - Online Assessment (MCQ + Coding)

  • The assessment comprises 15 MCQs (Algorithms, DSA & Programming Logic) and 2 coding questions to be completed within 60 minutes.
  • Each participant is allowed only one attempt.
  • The assessment must be completed in one sitting before the timer expires.

Round 2 - Case Study on Brand Visibility

  • Shortlisted participants from the Online Assessment Round will advance to this round.
  • You will analyse a Brand Visibility case study and answer a set of questions within 45 minutes.
  • Each participant is allowed only one attempt.
  • The round must be completed in one sitting before the timer expires.

Round 3 - Development Round

  • All shortlisted teams will receive the detailed problem statement once the round goes live.
  • Teams will be required to build a solution based on the problem statement and submit it as per the prescribed guidelines.
  • Submission requirements, including the GitHub repository link and any supporting documents, will be communicated before the round begins.
  • Detailed submission instructions and timelines will be shared with all shortlisted teams prior to the start of the round.

Round 4 - Prototype Showcase

  • Shortlisted teams will build a functional prototype based on their solution from the previous round.
  • The prototype should demonstrate the core user experience and the features outlined in the problem statement.
  • The team leader must submit the prototype along with any supporting documents, as per the submission guidelines.
  • Complete submission details will be shared with the shortlisted teams.
  • Only the team leader can make the submission.

Round 5 - Grand Finale

  • The top teams will present their solutions to the Adobe leadership at the Adobe headquarters in Noida.
  • Adobe will cover the travel and accommodation expenses for all students qualifying for the Grand Finale.

Rewards and Prizes:

  • 1st Prize - Each member of the Winning team will receive a MacBook Pro
  • 2nd Prize - Each member of the Winning team will receive a MacBook Neo
  • Top 50 participants to get PPIs and a chance to intern with Adobe with a stipend of INR 1,10,000 per month
  • National Finalists to get exclusive Adobe merchandise and a chance for a fully sponsored Adobe office visit
  • 50 shortlisted teams to get certificates from Adobe

Note: Only the 2028 batch is eligible for PPIs for an Internship.

Join our Discord community to stay updated, access how-to guides, find teammates, and get support during the build window.

At a Glance

  • Registration: Rolling — June 8–29
  • Build window: June 24– 2nd July
  • Who can build: Developers, PMs, operators & students
  • Career: Hiring fast-track to partner companies
  • Proof: Project certificates

Not just for developers. With Lemma SDK you can build entirely through prompting — no deep coding background needed. What matters most is clear thinking: a sharply defined problem, real product sense, and the judgment to ship something people would actually use. Developers, PMs, operators, and students are all welcome.



What You'll Build:

Build a working agentic app using Lemma SDK as your infrastructure layer. Lemma SDK is upcoming (launching on 24th June) open-source infrastructure for coding agents to build agentic apps that run real work. It provisions ai agents, datastores, document stores, frontend, backend, workflows, functions, and integrations to build ai apps end to end.

  • Pick any real-world problem: a specific user, a clear pain point, and a workflow worth solving.
  • Or build from one of our curated problem statements (to be shared over email after registration)
  • The core loop should work end-to-end and be demoable.
  • Bring your own IDE, AI coding tool, API key, builder platform, and hosting/deployment setup.

The Hiring Fast-Track

Your submission goes to work for you:

  • Submissions are evaluated for problem clarity, product thinking, and execution quality.
  • Top builders are matched to AI Product Engineer and AI Product Manager roles (full-time and internship role) at partner companies.
  • Your profile — resume, project summary, and a written rationale — goes directly to the hiring team. No cold applications.
  • Partner companies may invite you directly for a first-round interview. No CV screening, no recruiter filters.

Hiring partners: YesMadam · Binocs · Foxo · Zapdata · Corally


The Project Track (for top 10 teams, optional):

Top 10 teams get the chance to keep building — with the Lemma team behind them:

  • Two more weeks to refine your submission into a full-fledged product, with direct guidance on architecture, SDK usage, and product decisions.
  • A verified project certificate of contribution — a real credential, not participation filler.
  • The strongest projects published on the Lemma website as community templates.

  • June 24 — Lemma SDK launches publicly + build window begins
  • July 2nd — Submissions close (project + short writeup + working demo)
  • After judging — Results announced. Winners recognised, and shortlisted builders' profiles matched and introduced to partner companies. Partner companies may invite you directly for a first-round interview.

    Important Note: We are holding this event in our Discord community and we will be annoucing the results there. Only top 10 teams will be announced.

How We Judge

  • Problem clarity & real-world fit — 35%
  • Product judgment — 25%
  • Execution quality — 25%
  • Lemma SDK utilisation — 15%

What is Lemma?

Most software records what happened. Lemma is infrastructure for software that actually does the work — structured data, AI agents, automated workflows, and custom interfaces in one environment. The SDK is open-source and locally runnable, and it launches publicly on June 24 — the same day the hackathon begins, so everyone starts fresh.

title: ET AI Hackathon 2.0
description:

The ET AI Hackathon 2.0, in partnership with Unstop, is a nation-scale innovation challenge designed to discover and celebrate India’s brightest emerging AI talent. Building on the success of its first edition, this flagship platform brings together the country’s sharpest minds to solve real-world AI problem statements across business innovation, social impact, and open innovation domains.

Across a multi-phase journey, beginning with an online AI assessment, advancing into an intensive prototype build sprint, and culminating in a high-energy grand finale, participants ideate, innovate, and present transformative AI solutions.

ET AI Hackathon 2.0 is where ideas evolve into impactful products, and where the next generation of AI leaders takes shape.

Read more details - https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/et-ai-hackathon/2nd-edition

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Open to students, professionals, and AI enthusiasts across India.
  • Participation allowed individually or in teams of 1-4 members
  • Cross-college, cross-discipline, and cross-year teams are allowed
  • Ideal for developers, designers, and product thinkers building AI solutions
  • Each participant can be part of only one team

Rules and Guidelines:

  • Team formation must be completed before the Phase 1 assessment
  • No changes to team members will be allowed after the deadline
  • All ideas, code, documents, and assets must be original and created during the hackathon
  • Plagiarism, use of pre-built projects, or unauthorized third-party material will lead to disqualification
  • All submissions must be made via the Unstop platform within the given timelines
  • Licensed tools/datasets may be used only with valid authorization
  • Participants must ensure all submission links (GitHub, demo, docs) are public and accessible
  • Participants are expected to maintain professional and ethical conduct throughout the hackathon

Judging Criteria:

Prototypes will be evaluated based on:

  • Relevance to Problem Statement – How effectively the solution addresses the chosen problem
  • Innovation & Creativity – Originality and problem-solving approach
  • Technical Implementation – Quality of architecture, code, and use of AI
  • Business Viability – Practicality and real-world applicability
  • Presentation & Clarity – Effectiveness of demo, pitch, and communication
  • Impact & Scalability – Potential to create meaningful impact at scale
  • Final Authority:
  • All decisions made by the jury will be final and binding
  • The organisers reserve the right to modify rules, guidelines, or timelines if required

Rewards & Prizes:

  • Prize Pool ₹10,00,000
  • Winner - ₹5,00,000
  • 1st Runner-Up - ₹3,00,000
  • 2nd Runner-Up - ₹2,00,000

Beyond the prize money

  1. Chance to get PPIs + job & internship opportunities with leading AI-first companies
  2. Certificate of Participation for all participants who successfully submit in Phase 2
  3. National recognition across ET platforms for finalists and winners
  4. Direct access to industry experts, founders, and AI practitioners

Your Hackathon Journey:

  1. Register on Unstop - Sign up and secure your spot. 
  2. Form your team - Build a team of 1-4 members with complementary skills.
  3. Complete the MCQ assessment - Attempt an AI-proctored assessment to test your foundational knowledge.
  4. Get shortlisted for Phase 2 - Qualified teams are shortlisted based on MCQ scores and notified on the platform.
  5. Pick your problem statement - Choose from real-world AI challenges revealed at the start of Phase 2.
  6. Build & submit your prototype - Develop your AI solution and submit via Unstop before the deadline.
  7. Final shortlist announced - Top submissions are evaluated and shortlisted for the Grand Finale.
  8. Present at the Grand Finale - Pitch your solution to an industry jury and compete for ₹10 Lakh+ in prizes.
